"import csv
from openpyxl import Workbook

INPUT_FILE = "eng_si_02.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "output.xlsx"

def main():
    # Read the input CSV
    with open(INPUT_FILE, "r", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        reader = csv.reader(f)
        rows = [row for row in reader if row and any(cell.strip() for cell in row)]

    if not rows:
        raise ValueError("Input CSV is empty")

    header = rows[0]
    data_rows = rows[1:]

    # Map expected input columns by name for robustness
    col_idx = {name.strip().lower(): i for i, name in enumerate(header)}
    idx_run = col_idx["run"]
    idx_force = col_idx["force_lbf"]
    idx_length = col_idx["length_in"]
    idx_temp = col_idx["temp_f"]

    # Build workbook
    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "SI"

    out_header = ["run", "force_n", "length_mm", "temp_c"]
    ws.append(out_header)

    for row in data_rows:
        run_id = row[idx_run].strip()
        force_lbf = float(row[idx_force])
        length_in = float(row[idx_length])
        temp_f = float(row[idx_temp])

        force_n = round(force_lbf * 4.4482216152605, 3)
        length_mm = round(length_in * 25.4, 3)
        temp_c = round((temp_f - 32.0) * 5.0 / 9.0, 3)

        ws.append([run_id, force_n, length_mm, temp_c])

    wb.save(OUTPUT_FILE)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()"
